findings.message: Hero headline is 14 words ("What if managing money… just made sense? What if managing mo"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 10 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "From idea to reality" above "An idea became a product."; "Real Paisa screens · sample data" above "₹"; "Chapter two" above "What if tracking your spending required "; "Supported UPI app" above "₹486"; "Chapter three" above "Tracking is only the beginning."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "DuplicateCheck.kt", "From the home screen"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 13 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Scroll to begin", "From idea to reality", "Chapter one", "Chapter two").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 5 gradient fill(s): div.relative.overflow-hidden → linear-gradient(in oklab, rgb(7, 6, 11) 0%, rgb(18, 16, 25) 50%, rgb(7, 6, 11) 100%) | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(in oklab, rgb(7, 6, 11) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%) | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(to top in oklab, rgb(7, 6, 11) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 14 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.flex.items-start → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.bg-charcoal → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 0px 60px 120px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0px 0px 0px 1.5 | div.bg-charcoal → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 0px 60px 120px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0px 0px 0px 1.5

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill.

findings.message: 2 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.flex.h-10 340px | footer.border-t.border-hairline 390px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 7 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #fbf9f5, text #f5f1ea).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Indigo / violet (button #6d4aff).
findings.fix: Use the accent from the drawn palette.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Real Paisa screens · sample data" 3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Real Paisa screen · sample data" 3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Plus Jakarta Sans, Instrument Serif, JetBrains Mono).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 17 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 972px at 9888px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The h1 is 16px ("What if managing money… just made sense? What if m").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 24px from the left edge but only to 96px from the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
